title: Chore Coin announcements feed
description: Static JSON polled by every installed Chore Coin instance to surface release announcements, security notices, and product news. Kept intentionally simple — no per-user tracking, no auth.

generated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the feed was last updated. App uses this to decide whether to re-render even if the announcement list didn't change.

id.description: Stable unique identifier. Once used, never reused — the app tracks read state by id.

severity.description: info = 'just so you know', notice = new feature, warning = you may need to act, urgent = security or breaking change requiring attention.

title.description: One-line summary — shown as the notification headline.

body.description: Markdown body. Rendered in the parent dashboard's announcement drawer.

url.description: Optional 'learn more' link — e.g. to a release notes page or blog post.

minVersion.description: Optional semver constraint — only shown to installs at or above this version. Useful for announcements that only apply to certain versions.

maxVersion.description: Optional semver constraint — hide once the install has upgraded past this version. Useful for 'please upgrade from 0.1.x, it has a bug' style notices.
